1.tafsir: In the name of Allah the Exalted, I begin reading the Quran, seeking His aid and blessing by invoking His name. The basmalah consists of three of Allah's beautiful names: 1- Allah, meaning the One worthy of worship, and this is the most exclusive of names of Allah the Exalted. 2- Ar-Raḥmān, i.e., the Possessor of all-encompassing mercy, the Most Merciful in His Essence. 3- Ar-Raḥīm, i.e., the Bestower of mercy that reaches all He desires, for He bestows His Mercy upon whomever He wills from His creation, including His believing slaves.
1.surah_intro:
The Opening (Surah Al-Fatihah)
Meccan Surah
• Surah Objective(s):
Actualizing complete servitude to Allah the Exalted.
• Explanation:
Surah Al-Fatihah is called 'The Opening Chapter' because Allah begins the Quran with it. It is also referred to as Umm Al-Quran (Mother of the Quran) because it encompasses the Quran's themes, from the principles of faith to worship, among other matters. It is also called 'The Seven Oft-Repeated Verses.'

1.tafsir: Complete praise and all forms of extolment of majesty and perfection belong exclusively to Allah alone; He is the Lord of everything, its Creator, and its Manager. Al-Ālamūn (worlds) is the plural of Al-'Ālam (world) and refers to all in existence other than Allah.
Further extolling Allah, the Exalted, that He is the Most Merciful and Compassionate after praising Him in the preceding verse.

Glorification of Allah the Transcendent that he is the Owner of everything on the Day of Resurrection when a soul will not possess anything for another. The “Day of Judgment” is the Day of Recompense and Reckoning.

We single You out alone in all forms of worship and obedience, and we do not associate anyone with You. We seek help in all of our affairs from You alone, for all virtue belongs with You, and there is no helper other than You.

Guide us to the Straight Path, put us firmly upon it, and increase us in guidance. As-Sirat al-Mustaqim is the clear path in which there is no crookedness, and that is Islam, which Allah sent Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم with.

1.ayah: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
1.tafsir: The path of those slaves whom You have bestowed with guidance, such as the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs, and the pious, for they are the ones worthy of companionship. [And do not guide us] to the path of those who have earned Your anger after recognizing the Truth and not following it (i.e., the Jews) and not of those who went astray for being neglectful in seeking the Truth and being guided by it (i.e., the Christians).

411.tafsir: Alif Lām Mīm – This surah begins with disconnected letters, the explanation for which has already preceded in Surat Al-Baqarah.
411.surah_intro:
Luqman (Surah Luqman)
Meccan Surah
• Surah Objective(s):
The command to follow the wisdom outlined in the Quran and the warning against turning away from it.
• Explanation:

411.tafsir: O Messenger, these verses revealed to you are verses of the Book that speaks wisdom.
It is guidance and mercy for those who do good by fulfilling the rights of their Lord and the rights of His slaves.

411.ayah: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ يُوقِنُونَ
411.tafsir: Those who perform prayer as best they can and give Zakat of their wealth while being certain of the resurrection, account, and reward in the Afterlife.

411.ayah: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدٗى مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
411.tafsir: Those characterized as such are upon guidance from their Lord, and it is they who are successful by gaining whatever they seek and being distanced from what causes them fear.

411.ayah: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشۡتَرِي لَهۡوَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
411.tafsir:
After mentioning the traits of those who strive toward excellence, He mentions the traits of the evildoers, stating:
Some people, like An-Nadr Muhammed bin Al-Harith, tell stories to distract people from Allah's religion with ignorance and take Allah's words as a joke, mocking them. Those who possess these characteristics will have a humiliating torment awaiting them in the Afterlife.

411.ayah: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا وَلَّىٰ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَا كَأَنَّ فِيٓ أُذُنَيۡهِ وَقۡرٗاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
411.tafsir: When you read Our verses to him, he turns away in arrogance, as if he has not heard them, as if his ears are oblivious to sounds. So, O Messenger, warn him of a painful punishment that awaits him.

411.ayah: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
411.tafsir: Indeed, those who believe and do good deeds will have gardens of Paradise, where they shall live in luxury among everything Allah has prepared for them.

411.ayah: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
411.tafsir: They will remain therein [forever]. Allah has made them a true promise of which there is no doubt. He is the Almighty whom no one can overcome; the Wise in His creation, decree, and legislation.

411.ayah: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيۡرِ عَمَدٖ تَرَوۡنَهَاۖ وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٖۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ
411.tafsir: Allah (may He be Exalted) created the heavens, which are raised without any pillars, and pitched mountains on the Earth to hold it firmly in place so that it does not shake in convulsion. He dispersed animals throughout the Earth and sent down rainfall from the sky, causing the Earth to grow delightful plants, from which both humans and animals benefit.

411.ayah: هَٰذَا خَلۡقُ ٱللَّهِ فَأَرُونِي مَاذَا خَلَقَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۚ بَلِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
411.tafsir: O, polytheists, these all are from Allah's creation, so show Me what those you worship other than Allah have created. Instead, the wrongdoers are in apparent deviance from the truth because they attribute partners to Allah that cannot make anything but are themselves created.

515.ayah: مُّحَمَّدٞ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلۡكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ تَرَىٰهُمۡ رُكَّعٗا سُجَّدٗا يَبۡتَغُونَ فَضۡلٗا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضۡوَٰنٗاۖ سِيمَاهُمۡ فِي وُجُوهِهِم مِّنۡ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلتَّوۡرَىٰةِۚ وَمَثَلُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡإِنجِيلِ كَزَرۡعٍ أَخۡرَجَ شَطۡـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسۡتَغۡلَظَ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعۡجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلۡكُفَّارَۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ مِنۡهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٗ وَأَجۡرًا عَظِيمَۢا
515.tafsir: Muhammad is Allah's Messenger, and his companions are strict against the disbelievers that are at war with you and merciful, affectionate, and friendly among themselves. You will see them bowing and prostrating, seeking from Allah that He grace them with forgiveness, a generous reward, and that He becomes pleased with them. Their mark is on their faces due to prostrating in obedience to Allah. That is how the Torah has described them: the book revealed to Moses (peace be upon him). As for their mention in the Gospel, which was shown to Jesus, they are likened in their assisting one another and perfection like crops that have emerged as trim, then strengthened and stood straight up, pleasing the farmers with their strength and perfection. It is so that the disbelievers are angered by the power, steadfastness, and perfection they see within them. And Allah has promised those of the companions who believe in Him and do good deeds forgiveness for their sins; they will not be taken to account over their sins, and the great reward of Paradise.

515.ayah: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۖ وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ
515.tafsir: O you who believe in Allah and follow whatever He legislates, do not precede Allah or His Messenger in speech or action. Fear Allah by fulfilling His commands and refrain from that which He has prohibited. Indeed, Allah hears your statements and is aware of your actions. He does not miss any of them and will soon recompense you accordingly.
515.surah_intro:
The Rooms (Surah Al-Hujurat)
Medinan Surah
• Surah Objective(s):
The rectification of one's speech and explaining its impact on an individual's faith and the ethics of society.
• Explanation:

515.ayah: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَرۡفَعُوٓاْ أَصۡوَٰتَكُمۡ فَوۡقَ صَوۡتِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ وَلَا تَجۡهَرُواْ لَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ كَجَهۡرِ بَعۡضِكُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ أَن تَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَنتُمۡ لَا تَشۡعُرُونَ
515.tafsir: O you who believe in Allah and follow whatever He legislates, show good manners with His Messenger: do not raise your voices in his presence nor speak loudly to him out of respect for him, and do not call out his name as you do amongst each other. Rather, call him gently, saying, O Prophet, or O Messenger, it is feared that the reward of your deeds become nullified if you do so while you do not even realize it.

515.ayah: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصۡوَٰتَهُمۡ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمۡتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمۡ لِلتَّقۡوَىٰۚ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٌ
515.tafsir: Indeed, those who lower their voices near Allah's Messenger صلى الله عليه وسلم are the ones whose hearts Allah has examined for fear of Him and chosen them for it. For them is forgiveness for their sins; they will not be accounted for them, and they will receive a great reward on the Day of Judgment, which will be that Allah enters them into Paradise.

515.ayah: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلۡحُجُرَٰتِ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
515.tafsir: O Messenger, indeed, most of the Bedouins who call out to you from behind your wives' houses do not understand.
